headline: Why won't he commit to me?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

On the two Magician/Hanged Man/Fool decks — one set of copy, verb swapped ('turned' face-down, 'chose' face-up).

🔴 THESE ASK FOR A PREDICTION OUTRIGHT, which is the exact thing the funnel forbids, so the no-verdict rule runs in BOTH directions plus a no-timeframe rule: 'he will, give it time' reads as a promise and 'he never will' is a pronouncement on a man she loves. 🔴 The bans in tests/tarot-commitment-copy.test.ts are WHOLE-BEAT rather than clause-level, so 'not enough' and 'too much' are unavailable even inside a refusal — the usual absolution form had to be rebuilt without them.

⚠️ THIS HOOK PRESUPPOSES HIS REFUSAL, which opens a failure mode the others do not have: the answer sliding into HER fault. 123 real concerns off this lander show she has usually already started turning the question on herself — 'I feel he's never really tried. Like I'm an option even tho he said different', 'I feel inconsistent energy from him', 'he says he loves me and I believe him but there's something underlying that I can't explain'. So the 'why' is routed to where HE is stuck and left there — never a character verdict, never invented — and what gets affirmed is that her read is sound and the tiredness is earned.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — a white band round his dark hair.
You asked why he won't commit to you. Your hand went to the man who decides.
So the hold on this isn't yours, dear. Nothing you did put it there.
And the tools for building are all laid out in front of him, dear.
But having the tools is not the same as picking them up, dear.
That's why you get the words, dear, and the week after looks the same.
Let me look closer at what stands in the way of a choice…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — his arms are out of sight, and his body makes a triangle.
You asked why he won't commit to you. Your hand went to the card that stalls.
So something has him stuck, dear. You've been feeling exactly that.
And his arms are out of sight, dear. You can't see what he's holding.
But where he is stuck is his to name, dear. Not mine, and not yours.
That's why every reason you land on slides off, dear. None of them stick.
Let me look closer at what has this stuck in place…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the little dog has its tail straight up.
You asked why he won't commit to you. Your hand went to the one who ties nothing down.
So nothing in his life is tied down, dear. You saw that early.
And the little dog has its tail straight up, dear. It knows the mood.
But loose isn't the same as gone, dear. He still walks beside you.
That's why asking for more never turns into a row. It just slides off.
Let me look closer at what has been keeping this loose…
